newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * The Senate started debates on existing legislation on foreign investments. Under new proposals, foreign investors would be allowed to own land in Romania for the periods they operate businesses in this country.
The Senate ended debates on the wine bill.
* Parliament's lower chamber of Deputies resumed debates on traffic code.
